name: Shiramine Haruto
source:
“I’m not expecting much of you. So please just respect this one thing. Don’t intrude on our business.”

The student who’s chosen for the role of Mary in the school nativity play. He’s a sociable but private person who speaks as if he’s playing with you, giving off the feeling he’s planning something, and smiles with intention. Though he keeps himself well put together, behind that he’s extremely empathetic to others, and hates people who use violence for no reason. He has a low blood pressure and is often tired, struggling to wake up in the mornings. His parents live in Tokyo and run an antiques store.
He’s cocky towards Kaya, but is weak to Tsujimura.

[Source: [url=http://www.tarhs.com/chara.html]official website profile[/url]]
